A clear picture of your numbers

Service saves use customers who had that service. Play saves use the matching outcome pair, like DPS ÷ (DPS + DPD). Mobile sales track both orders and total mobiles sold, divided by all logged calls. Triple-play groups three or more services.

Records & backups

Your records and goals are saved to your account, so you can continue on another device. Download a backup whenever you want a separate copy of your records.

Restore a backup to merge records into your account. Conflicting entries are not overwritten.
